name: Introduction to Metaversity
author: unity_APaIqtgiepoSdA
description:
This is a downgraded version of the game, as Unity LEGO Microgame has been deprecated.

Click "Play", [TAB]. "Volume on" and "Fullscreen" buttons at the lower right.
Hide mouse point: click on screen
Show mouse point: [ESC].
Move: Arrow keys or [W][A][S][D]
High jump [space] * 2
